scope: Remaining 44 existing debate owners complementary to earlier 11. This is a Catholic-reply passage-to-claim source-scope inventory, NOT 44 full debate certifications. 3 archived debate owners remain archived.
method: A paragraph locator supports only the bounded proposition described; a page view is not equivalent to exhaustive textual, historical, clinical, translation or 8-stage claim-level verification. General-source indexes and uncollated manuals are flagged.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Basic goods, marriage and care of offspring are intelligible under natural law
cases.claim_scope_limit: The source cannot by itself decide which acts civil law ought to prohibit.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Object, intention and circumstances contribute differently to moral judgment
cases.claim_scope_limit: Fletcher's own argument is separately and only partially documented.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Biblical adultery, marriage and bodily holiness premises
cases.claim_scope_limit: The registered source is a general Vulgate index, not direct verse-targeted evidence for every modern technology.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Body, sanctification and moral obligations presented in Pauline texts
cases.claim_scope_limit: A direct chapter/verse source must replace the generic index for precise passage certification.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Intrinsically wrong acts remain barred by negative moral norms
cases.claim_scope_limit: This contemporary magisterial text alone does not demonstrate each alleged century-by-century historical continuity claim.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Serious difficulties with non-irreformable teaching call for loyal inquiry, not automatic dissent
cases.claim_scope_limit: The theologians' vocational instruction must not be treated as a standalone handbook on individual clinical conscience.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Theologian's inquiry and nonparallel magisterium are distinguished
cases.claim_scope_limit: A context-bound instruction on theologians cannot be made a universal guarantee that any personal disagreement is permitted.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Passion and involuntary constraints affect moral responsibility
cases.claim_scope_limit: Objective wrongness does not itself establish mortal guilt in any individual episode.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Chastity orders sexual desire according to reason
cases.claim_scope_limit: This original theological definition does not establish or rebut clinical causal claims about repression.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Consecrated virginity has a positive theological meaning without calling marriage evil
cases.claim_scope_limit: A papal theological treatment does not establish representative mental-health outcomes for celibate people.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Marriage requires valid consent and normally observes canonical form
cases.claim_scope_limit: Canonical form exceptions exist; this locator is not a complete inventory of canonical exemptions.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Scandal and avoidable inducement toward wrongdoing may matter
cases.claim_scope_limit: Scandal doctrine does not state that sharing a residence is automatically fornication.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Chastity concerns reasonable government of appetite
cases.claim_scope_limit: Perception and deliberate consent must remain distinct; no universal second-glance rule follows.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Marital fidelity and deliberate affection are bound by covenant
cases.claim_scope_limit: Application to unmarried exclusive dating promises is ethical inference, not a papal dating code.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Chastity concerns acts outside marriage; intentional behavior cannot be excused only as pre-marital preparation
cases.claim_scope_limit: The statement of canon 1057 must carry the registered CIC source separately.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Sterility and antecedent perpetual impotence are distinct canonical categories
cases.claim_scope_limit: A legal distinction does not alone prove all of the philosophical premises concerning male-female marriage.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Sterility does not impede marriage; antecedent perpetual impotence is treated differently
cases.claim_scope_limit: This legal distinction should not be confused with a prediction of pregnancy.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Indissolubility, qualified exceptional dissolutions, and protected separation are distinct
cases.claim_scope_limit: Not every valid marriage is ratified and consummated sacramental marriage; avoid absolute overstatement.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Prior bond, invalid consent and narrow bond dissolutions are juridically distinct
cases.claim_scope_limit: A civil divorce must not be described as necessarily dissolving a valid sacramental marriage.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Conjugal fidelity requires exclusivity that spousal agreement cannot cancel
cases.claim_scope_limit: Humanae Vitae adds analysis of conjugal acts; source roles are distinct.

cases.passage_locator: Traditional Moral Theology manual, treatment of marital acts (precise section not collated)
cases.bounded_supported_claim: Manual discussion is a research lead on marital acts
cases.claim_scope_limit: ARCHIVED. Full original manual paragraphs and variant cases have not been collated; no source certification.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Exclusive marital fidelity cannot be traded by private agreement
cases.claim_scope_limit: ARCHIVED. The historical norm is sourced; concrete contemporary scenarios require separate reasoning.

cases.passage_locator: Traditional Moral Theology manual, treatment of perversions (precise section not collated)
cases.bounded_supported_claim: Manual citation is a research lead for specific act distinctions
cases.claim_scope_limit: ARCHIVED. No complete original manual passage collation for claimed variation among Catholic moralists.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Directly frustrating generation and reluctant toleration are treated separately
cases.claim_scope_limit: Casti states a norm; later NFP and clinical classification is not identical with that text.

cases.passage_locator: Italian original 29 Oct 1951, discussion of periodi infecondi and seri motivi
cases.bounded_supported_claim: Pius XII's conditions for recurring recourse to infertile periods
cases.claim_scope_limit: The Italian original is directly available; English/French translation and intervening evolution remain to be checked.

cases.passage_locator: Italian original 29 Oct 1951, seri motivi and periodi infecondi
cases.bounded_supported_claim: Serious reasons and abstaining during fertile times addressed
cases.claim_scope_limit: Italian original context, not proof that every later natural family-planning marketing slogan is theological doctrine.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Reluctant non-choosing spouse may lack sin in narrowly stated circumstances
cases.claim_scope_limit: No automatic clearance of all modes of material cooperation or all coerced-marriage questions.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Masturbation is treated as an objectively seriously disordered sexual act
cases.claim_scope_limit: Subjective guilt may be lessened by affective immaturity, habit and psychological factors.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Pornography and lust are defined with objective moral concerns
cases.claim_scope_limit: Original ecclesial paragraph does not quantify empirical consequences of pornography consumption.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Sexual objectification and production of erotic images raise questions beyond consent
cases.claim_scope_limit: Self-produced intimate recordings are a prudential application; the CCC is not a clinical privacy-risk study.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Assessment of homosexual acts and individual culpability are distinguishable
cases.claim_scope_limit: Do not infer psychiatric pathology or automatically judge personal guilt.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Sterility is not an impediment but specified incapacity to consummate may be
cases.claim_scope_limit: Application to same-sex marriage involves other philosophical and magisterial premises.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Violence, malice and contempt against persons are condemned
cases.claim_scope_limit: A moral doctrine's content and historically contingent pastoral abuses are separate issues.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: The inclination's traditional moral qualification differs from chosen actions and culpability
cases.claim_scope_limit: Historic document is not a clinical classification of sexual orientation as mental illness.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Institutional public-law argument concerning marriage and social welfare
cases.claim_scope_limit: This is the CDF's argument, not a neutral settled causal finding about children and all family forms.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Human bodily dignity is the theological premise invoked for sex-change intervention judgments
cases.claim_scope_limit: This doctrinal text is not an empirical comparative outcomes meta-analysis.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: General sex-change judgment distinguishes treatment of genital anomalies
cases.claim_scope_limit: Clinical risks and diagnoses require appropriate clinical sources; SOC8 is not magisterium.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: IVF morally evaluated apart from embryo destruction as substitution for conjugal act
cases.claim_scope_limit: The result is a specific normative claim; it is not an empirical claim that all fertility assistance equals IVF.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Surrogate motherhood rejected irrespective of commercial payment
cases.claim_scope_limit: Original 1987 term scope and modern variants need careful comparison.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Violence and impaired voluntariness limit meaningful human consent
cases.claim_scope_limit: No inference about jurisdiction-specific assault law from Thomistic text.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Chastity and virginity are one aspect of broader virtue and Christian vocation
cases.claim_scope_limit: The Francis 2013 pastoral balance claim must have its own first-person interview source attached.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Chastity is direction of desires under reason rather than hatred of sexuality
cases.claim_scope_limit: Freud's 1908 psychology is historically specific, not a 2026 clinical causal study.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Moral objects and reasons rather than good intention alone ground moral evaluations
cases.claim_scope_limit: The philosophical argument for a specific contested act needs more than repeating the formal principle.

cases.bounded_supported_claim: Practical natural-law reasoning distinguishes facts and normative goods
cases.claim_scope_limit: No single Catholic doctrine source substitutes for accurate contemporary medical and psychological evidence.
